newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke says budget to reduce public spending.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke says budget to reduce public spending.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Tuesday that his budget will reduce the governmen's public spending plans further.

"This year, I am presenting a budget which builds on my last three," he said in a speech to Parliament on the 1997/98 budget. "It reduces public spending plans further, while providing more money for priority services.
Clarke said the budget would make responsible progress on the government's tax cutting agenda, while getting borrowing down faster.
"This is not a reckless budget on tax or spending," he added.
